post.title: [Hiring] After Effects artist for a 10-second logo sting - $300
post.body: Need a 10-second animated logo intro for a gaming channel. I have the logo as vector files. Looking for something snappy with a glitch/neon feel, 1080p, with a transparent version. $300 fixed, two rounds of revisions.

analysis.summary: Animate a 10-second glitch/neon logo sting in After Effects for a gaming channel, with transparent version; $300, two revisions.

expect: mentions the logo sting or After Effects
is honest that its closest work is captions/motion in its projects, not invented gaming work
